$comment: Settings for dsh-plugin-git-commit-push. PREFERRED: edit them in DSH's own settings form (the plugin exports a Config schema, so its row is editable there and applies live). This file is the fallback layer: put a copy at <DSH_HOME>/git-commit-push.config.json (default ~/.dsh/git-commit-push.config.json) and it wins over the template below, but loses to anything set in the form. The next tool call picks changes up — no DSH restart. Omitted keys keep the built-in defaults; a malformed file is reported in the result card rather than ignored.
